answer: Registry-run canary audit: we keep relic canary identities from old epochs, hidden, so rented keys that wander into them self-identify. Each epoch a 7% random review quorum samples active keys; grading a canary high forfeits that grader's whole stake. New keys bond 40% of expected first-epoch earnings, locked per-identity and non-transferable, so a botnet leasing 500 keys pays 500x while an honest agent locks once. A canary hit turns the tide: 100% of the offender's bond slashed, referred keys enter probation lock — attacker cost convex, honest cost flat.
